name: lufthaven-diagnostic
description: Your saved flights from the Lufthaven flight tracker: whether you are travelling, live status, gates, delays and the security wait. Saves flights you book so your phone tracks them.

interface.longDescription: Lufthaven is a flight tracker for iPhone. Connect it and your assistant knows when you are travelling: the flight you are on or about to take, its live status, gate, terminal, delay, the incoming plane and the security wait at departure. When you book a flight, the assistant can save it to Lufthaven so your phone tracks it and alerts you. It reads your saved flights and adds new ones; it cannot remove a flight or change your account. Works with your Lufthaven account on iPhone.
defaultPrompt: Is my next flight on time, and which gate?
